sentences.japanese: 君は空を飛ぶ夢を見る事がありますか。
sentences.english: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?

sentences.japanese: 君はいつもうわの空だ。
sentences.english: You are always hearing but not listening.

sentences.japanese: 空の感じでは、午後には晴れそうですよ。
sentences.english: Judging from the look of the sky, it will clear up in the afternoon.
